description: §19.9.1 "Every value a route delivers (S480)" — a server function handles its failed `?{}` where it is written (`.QueryFailed(m) :> { out = m; }`) and RETURNS the driver message. In a production build (every build but a dev one) the delivered string is blanked: the client's cell holds "", never "no such column: secret_col". RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real" (the users table has no `secret_col` column, so the query fails in the driver).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 16 (gap g-impl1-sql-driver-text-reraised-crosses-wire-s474)
rationale: ruling item 16: "the production-build withhold applies to every value a route delivers, returned as well as failed". §19.9.1: a delivered string "is blanked (the empty string) when it contains a whole driver message the request's failed queries produced".
